# fgets(buf, 100, f) where f has \x00 at start
# Actually let me just test with a file

    f.write(b'\x00hello\nworld\n')

# Read it back with fgets-like behavior

    chunk = f.readline()
    print('First line bytes:', list(chunk))
    print('First line strlen:', len(chunk.rstrip(b'\n').rstrip(b'\r')))
    print('strlen via python:', len(chunk.rstrip(b'\n')))
"
